svg.title: Runnable local résumé comparison in three stages
svg.desc: Admission commits Job and Outbox in PostgreSQL. Delivery uses a relay, durable RabbitMQ and a leased Celery worker. Completion writes the same database and React polls Django. Dotted arrows export safe metadata; the disabled Bedrock option is separate.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: C · Commit and review · same database and API

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B · Deliver and process · Docker Compose

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A · Admit durable work · Docker Compose
